title: Mara and the Colony
author: Wren Winterbourne
blurb: Vesper Iversen, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
